app.name: agdash
app.home: agdash, go to the live board

shell.readOnlyDetail: agdash observes your agents and never changes them.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address is not part of agdash.

board.label: Board
board.title: Live board
board.purpose: Every agent session running on this machine, with its state and the evidence behind it.
board.what: Active, waiting and idle sessions grouped by harness and project, with sessions started by other sessions nested under them.

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.purpose: Every session agdash has recorded, most recently active first, with its harness, model, folder and size.

search.label: Search
search.title: Search
search.purpose: Find sessions by what was asked, said or run.

board.label: By project
board.title: Sessions by project
board.purpose: Sessions grouped by the WorkChord project they work under.
board.what: Each WorkChord project with the agents working under it, their tasks, and the evidence for every mapping.

unmapped.label: Unmapped
unmapped.title: Unmapped sessions
unmapped.purpose: Sessions with no evidence linking them to a WorkChord project.
unmapped.what: A queue of sessions agdash could not map, to map by hand or by a folder rule.

usage.label: Usage
usage.title: Usage
usage.purpose: Tokens, cost and time by harness, model and project.
usage.what: Usage as each harness reported it, with missing numbers shown as missing rather than zero.

tools.label: Tools
tools.title: Tool use
tools.purpose: Which tools agents call, and how often.
tools.what: Tool calls by harness, model and project, with their outcomes.

sources.label: Sources
sources.title: Sources
sources.purpose: What agdash can see on this machine.
sources.what: Each harness agdash found, the files it reads, and any records it could not understand.

workchord.label: WorkChord
workchord.title: WorkChord
workchord.purpose: Connect a WorkChord server to map sessions to projects, agents and tasks.
workchord.what: Your connected servers and what each one lets agdash read.

data.label: Data
data.title: Data
data.purpose: How long agdash keeps history, and exporting it.
data.what: Retention settings and exports of sessions to JSONL or Markdown.

empty.noneBody: Sessions appear here once the agdash service has read your harnesses' files.
empty.filteredBody: Clear a filter or widen the dates to see more.

error.unreachableBody: Make sure the service is running on this machine, then try again.
error.refusedBody: The page did not present the service's local token. Open agdash from its app, or restart it.
error.serverBody: Something went wrong while reading the history. Try again.

search.label: Search sessions
search.placeholder: Words from a prompt, reply, thought or command
search.promptBody: Type words from what was asked, said or run. End a word with * to match its beginning.
search.noneBody: Check the spelling, try fewer words, or clear the filters.
search.failed: The search could not be completed.
